title: The trajectory index does not say which member a session belongs to
foundBy: session agent, while reading the member trajectories of a `make demo` run

evidence.verified: `make demo-trajectories` on a real archive printed `built 3 member site(s)`. The index listed `orchestrator`, `developer` and `qa`, and each link opened that member's own sessions.

details:
`cs-tracer` titles a session by what the agent called it, which is the dispatch, for example `Campaign dispatch d002 execution`. Every member also reports the same working directory. One site built over all three members could therefore not say whose session was whose.

`make demo-trajectories` now builds one site per member, under a small index page that lists the members by name.

notes.text: This is a workaround in the Makefile. The better fix belongs in `cs-tracer`, which could label a session by the directory it was read from. One site would then show every member side by side, with their tokens and cost.
This is filed upstream in the tracer repository's ledger as TRC-005. When `cs-tracer` can say which directory a session came from, `make demo-trajectories` can go back to one site over every member.
